operational_caveats: Existing authenticated relay and HTTPS tunnel must remain running. A changed temporary tunnel URL needs pairing update.
Both LotKeys browser instances need the same hub.json pairing. The Android companion uses device.json. Browser pairing remains local and PIN-protected, not synced through customer Drive data.
The debug APK installs alongside the old Bridge. Stop the old notification Bridge before using Phone Mirror.
Android SMS installer restrictions, permissions and OEM battery behavior must be verified on the actual phone.
Phone-off detection is heartbeat-based (about 25 seconds), not instantaneous.
Foreground service and reconnect code have compiled, but screen-off, Doze, reboot and modem behavior have not been proven here.
No automatic resend. A request can already have reached the phone before a network error; check the phone before retrying. Native browser send requests expire after eight seconds.
Current local release intentionally uses the exact compiled Android source, not later uncompiled hardening proposals.
Direct phone outgoing SMS should appear via provider refresh; this was simulated, not tested on the user phone.
